command:
mkdir -p /root/ca/oscomparison-root-ca && cd /root/ca/oscomparison-root-ca && \
openssl genrsa -out rootCA.key 4096 2>&1 && \
openssl req -x509 -new -nodes -key rootCA.key -sha256 -days 3650 \
  -subj "/CN=OS Comparison Root CA/O=OS Comparison Lab" \
  -addext "basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE" \
  -addext "keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign" \
  -out rootCA.crt 2>&1 && \
chmod 600 rootCA.key && \
openssl x509 -in rootCA.crt -noout -subject -issuer -dates

mkdir -p /root/ca/oscomparison-root-ca && cd /root/ca/oscomparison-root-ca && \
openssl genrsa -out rootCA.key 4096 2>&1 && \
openssl req -x509 -new -nodes -key rootCA.key -sha256 -days 3650 \
  -subj "/CN=OS Comparison Root CA/O=OS Comparison Lab" \
  -addext "basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE" \
  -addext "keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign" \
  -out rootCA.crt 2>&1 && \
chmod 600 rootCA.key && \
openssl x509 -in rootCA.crt -noout -subject -issuer -dates
stdout:
subject=CN=OS Comparison Root CA, O=OS Comparison Lab
issuer=CN=OS Comparison Root CA, O=OS Comparison Lab
notBefore=Sep 29 14:00:47 2026 GMT
notAfter=Sep 26 14:00:47 2036 GMT

command:
cp /root/ca/oscomparison-root-ca/rootCA.crt /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.crt && \
update-ca-trust extract && \
echo "---verify trust---" && \
trust list --filter=ca-anchors | grep -A2 "OS Comparison Root CA"

cp /root/ca/oscomparison-root-ca/rootCA.crt /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.crt && \
update-ca-trust extract && \
echo "---verify trust---" && \
trust list --filter=ca-anchors | grep -A2 "OS Comparison Root CA"
stdout:
---verify trust---
    label: OS Comparison Root CA
    trust: anchor
    category: authority

command:
grep -c "OS Comparison Root CA" /etc/pki/tls/certs/ca-bundle.crt; \
cd /root/ca/oscomparison-root-ca && \
openssl genrsa -out leaf.key 2048 2>&1 && \
openssl req -new -key leaf.key -subj "/CN=test.oscomparison.local" -out leaf.csr 2>&1 && \
openssl x509 -req -in leaf.csr -CA rootCA.crt -CAkey rootCA.key -CAcreateserial -days 365 -sha256 -out leaf.crt 2>&1 && \
openssl verify leaf.crt

grep -c "OS Comparison Root CA" /etc/pki/tls/certs/ca-bundle.crt; \
cd /root/ca/oscomparison-root-ca && \
openssl genrsa -out leaf.key 2048 2>&1 && \
openssl req -new -key leaf.key -subj "/CN=test.oscomparison.local" -out leaf.csr 2>&1 && \
openssl x509 -req -in leaf.csr -CA rootCA.crt -CAkey rootCA.key -CAcreateserial -days 365 -sha256 -out leaf.crt 2>&1 && \
openssl verify leaf.crt
stdout:
1
Certificate request self-signature ok
subject=CN=test.oscomparison.local
leaf.crt: OK
